title: initialize
description: The first call on every connection to a plugin. The engine offers the protocol versions it speaks and the plugin picks one. A reply whose protocol was not offered, or whose name, version or hooks differ from the installed manifest, refuses the plugin. Unknown fields are ignored. ConnectRPC: basalt.plugin.v1.PluginService/Initialize. See CONTRACT.md, Plugins, Protocol.

hooks.description: The hooks the engine will call: the manifest's hooks.

config.description: The entry's config from engine.json, {} when it has none.

maxMessageBytes.description: Largest message either side may send: 4 MiB.

maxInFlight.description: Hook calls the engine has open on this entry at once. health and shutdown are not counted: each has a slot of its own.

hooks.description: The same hooks object as the manifest's.
